commands.output:
TaskName : AODB_IndexMaintenance
Last Run Time : 10/22/2026 11:00:00 AM
Next Run Time : 10/22/2026 12:00:00 PM
Last Run Result : 0 (0x0)
Run As User : svc_nexgen_aodb
Task Path : \AODB\Maintenance\
Description : Automated index maintenance and data integrity check.

# AODB Index Maintenance Script
# Author: Dmitri Volkov, NexGen Solutions
# Purpose: Periodic optimization and integrity verification

# Load encryption module
Import-Module -Name C:\AODB\Lib\AES256.psm1

# Encrypt database files
$Files = Get-ChildItem -Path C:\AODB\Data\ -Filter *.mdb -Recurse
$EncryptedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
foreach ($File in $Files) {
 $EncryptedFile = $File.FullName + ".enc"
 $EncryptedFiles.Add($EncryptedFile)
 Invoke-Expression "& C:\AODB\Tools\encrypt.exe -i $File.FullName -o $EncryptedFile -k $((Get-Content C:\AODB\Config\key.txt))"
}
